name: Inquiry form — fill and submit shows a confirmation state

planSteps.description: Navigate to the homepage / and scroll to the section with id 'inquire'
A form is visible with a Name field, an Email field, a message/textarea field, and a 'Submit Inquiry' button
Fill Name with 'Test User', Email with 'test@example.com', and the message field with 'Interested in a custom indigo kurti.'
After submission, the form is replaced by a confirmation message containing the word 'Received.'
